import urllib.request, json

# 1. Login
req_login = urllib.request.Request(
    'http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/auth/login',
    data=json.dumps({'email': 'staff@carebridge.ai', 'password': 'CareBridge#Staff2026!Admin'}).encode(),
    headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req_login) as resp:
    token = json.loads(resp.read().decode())['access_token']

headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}

# 2. Test GET /api/patients
req_get = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/patients?page=1&limit=10', headers=headers)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req_get) as resp:
    d = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    print('[1] GET Patients:', 'Total:', d['total'], 'Returned:', len(d['patients']), 'Stats:', d['stats'])
    target_patient = d['patients'][0]
    pid = target_patient['_id']
    pname = target_patient['name']

# 3. Test Search by stripped phone
req_phone = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/patients?search=9876543101', headers=headers)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req_phone) as resp:
    dp = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    print('[2] Search Phone 9876543101:', len(dp['patients']), 'Found:', dp['patients'][0]['name'] if dp['patients'] else 'None')

# 4. Record Vitals
v_payload = {
    'patient_id': pid,
    'heart_rate': 78,
    'systolic_bp': 122,
    'diastolic_bp': 80,
    'spo2': 98.5,
    'temperature': 36.8,
    'blood_sugar': 98,
    'notes': 'Routine clinical observation'
}
req_v = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/vitals', data=json.dumps(v_payload).encode(), headers=headers)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req_v) as resp:
    vr = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    print('[3] Record Vitals Status 201:', vr['message'], 'Vital ID:', vr['vital_id'])

# 5. Verify updated telemetry in patient get
req_get2 = urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/patients?search={pid}', headers=headers)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req_get2) as resp:
    d2 = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    p2 = d2['patients'][0]
    print('[4] Updated Patient Telemetry:', p2['name'], 'Level:', p2['telemetry_level'], 'Vital HR:', p2['latest_vital']['heart_rate'])

print('--- ALL PATIENT MONITORING TESTS PASSED! ---')
